## The evidence

**Setup.** The backend LLM is the Deepseek-V3 API. The reviewer is Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct fine-tuned with LoRA (rank 8) on A100 GPUs.

**Reviewer vs. humans.** Pearson correlation with human assessment: direct generation **0.0058**, multi-turn dialogue **0.4251**, structured thinking (theirs) **0.6810**. The structured format clearly helps. The paper does not describe in detail how the human assessments were obtained.

**User study.** Nine AI students were randomly assigned to three groups (so about three each): web search plus manual reading, an LLM tutoring assistant, or GoAI Idea Studio. In two hours they did *Frontier Mapping* (a one-page summary with baselines, extensions, contrasts, datasets/tools and prerequisites) and *Creative Ideation* (one or two project ideas).

| | SUS | Mental load | Temporal load | Avg. NASA-TLX | Idea score |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Web | n/a | 15.33 | 16.67 | 13.83 | 5.67 |
| LLM | 85.33 | 8.33 | 7.67 | 7.72 | 6.33 |
| GoAI | 87.67 | 5.33 | 3.67 | 6.06 | 7.33 |

Lower NASA-TLX means lower load. GoAI had the lowest mental and temporal load and the highest idea score, with usability comparable to the LLM assistant.
